findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] alternative-mitigation-accepted: DELETE /menu/{item_id} carries auth=Depends(Requires(Permission.MANAGE_MENU)) alongside get_current_user, and utils.delete_menu_item re-checks authz.require(Permission.MANAGE_MENU) at the point data changes. Permissions resolve server-side from the token-derived role via the centralized ROLE_PERMISSIONS table (apis/auth/utils/authz.py); denials raise 403 with an opaque detail, and no role/scope is read from the request body. A permission-based dependency is used instead of OAuth2 SecurityScopes but enforces the same property: authentication plus a specific, server-authoritative permission per operation. Router-level Depends(get_current_user) groups in apis/router.py make protection the default for new routes. No residual bare-Depends-only authorization pattern found. | verdict=pass confidence=high
